dataset_protocol: Train from source train split; source validation split divided into disjoint validation and test subsets using seed 43. This is the 3,000-per-class quick baseline, not the earlier mixed COCO + Nature + Tiny-GenImage V3 experiment.
threshold_rule: likely_real if P(real) >= threshold, otherwise likely_ai_generated
limitation: Scores estimate model behavior on these specific splits; they are not proof of provenance and do not guarantee performance on unseen generators or domains. The real-image false-positive rate on the held-out test split (4.0%) was higher than the validation target (3.0%); threshold calibration does not guarantee the same rate on unseen data.
